chapter_mission: Iresh aftermath. Sela remains wary but respects Ben conditionally. Tavi survives but is shaken. Give Sela and Tavi an imperfect reunion: anger, relief, practical care, and no easy sentimentality. Talon suspects Ben’s holocron decision is not clean. Before they part, Talon gives Ben a plain future-call offer rather than a sentimental declaration: if Ben needs him, call. Talon frames it with reluctant humor - he will complain first, then come; if it involves prison food, Hutt paperwork, or dressing a Wookiee for a diplomatic reception, he is charging double.
chapter_turn: They return to Coruscant with the case mostly resolved and the dangerous knowledge unresolved. # Coda — Dangerous Aftermath (Provisional) Act purpose: Resolve the Book 1 case while leaving the morally dangerous threads alive.
